title: ICC prosecution seeks admission of expert report, 3 testimonies in Duterte case

blocks.text: The prosecution at the International Criminal Court (ICC) has filed separate applications seeking to introduce an expert report and the previously recorded testimonies of three witnesses as evidence in the crimes against humanity case against former Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte.
